title: City Asphalt Services
label: Website Redesign
description: I redesigned the City Asphalt Services website using WordPress and Elementor Pro, delivering a modern, responsive, and user-focused experience. The project involved rebuilding page layouts, improving navigation, and creating a clean visual design that better represents the company’s asphalt and civil construction services. I optimized the website for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, ensuring consistent performance across all screen sizes. Additionally, I enhanced loading speed, implemented SEO-friendly page structures, and integrated contact and quote request forms to improve user engagement. The redesigned website provides a professional online presence that effectively showcases the company’s services and encourages potential customers to get in touch.
